name: RC-B10-0567/2025 – After § 3 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and sentencing of academics Bahruz Samadov and Igbal Abilov in Azerbaijan
part_text: 3a. Equally condemns Azerbaijan’s breaches of human rights and international law beyond its borders, notably its targeted assassination plots in the EU and its destabilisation campaigns interfering in Member States’ internal affairs;
